experiment.description: Geography Shorts: the country a line is about covered by its flag, against a flat colour (owner: 'test both'; judged on held after the hook)
experiment.on: Countries for this Short (weekly loop, cycle 1, geo-flag-fill, on): every country a line is about is covered by its own flag instead of a flat colour: give its map fill `flag: "<Natural Earth name>"` beside `fill` (remotion/src/flat/flags.tsx; `hasFlag` lists the table; a country it lacks keeps its colour), painted or drawn in on the word that names it, and traced as always.
experiment.off: Countries for this Short (weekly loop, cycle 1, geo-flag-fill, off): every country a line is about is filled with a flat colour (the champion), painted or drawn in on its word and traced as always; no flag fills (a small planted flag on a pole is fine).
experiment.why: 0 of 8 Shorts a side have two days of data; day 0 of 7
